title: Uth Laal Ali Akbar Khat Sughra Ka Aya Hai
body:
Uth Laal Ali Akbar Khat Sughra Ka Aya Hai (x2)
Beemaar Nay Ro Ro Kar Tujhay Dukhra Sunaya Hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Din Raat Guzaroon Mein Furqat Mein Teri Ro Kar (x2)
Is Ghar Ki Udasi Nay Mujhay Kitna Rulaya Hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Teri Yaad Jalati Hai Is Dil Ko Meray Bhaiyya (x2)
Yeh Din Bhi Meray Bhaiyya Kismat Ne Dikhaya Hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Seenay Pe Sina Kha Ke Neend Ayee Tujhay Ban Mein (x2)
Maqtal Ki Hawaoon Nay Paigham Sunaya Hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Ab Mujh Pe Taras Khao Din Raat Tarapti Hoon (x2)
Yeh Aakhri Sansein Hain Aur Maut Ka Saya Hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Ik Khwab Ajab Dekha Haye Khoon Ki Lagi Mehndi (x2)
Aur Ashkon Ki Larion Say Tera Sehra Sajaya Hai
